verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents an API-based, server-driven integration alongside its SDKs. API-accessible fleet management (locations, zones) and the Refunds API support it, and Stripe publishes an OpenAPI specification for its API. A community developer independently praises the ability to fully integrate with the API at the terminal level; the probe's 404 on docs-domain OpenAPI paths does not contradict the published spec repository. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of Terminal-specific API reference endpoints (e.g., reader action calls) in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader
You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard.
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.
the ability to fully integrate with the API on a terminal level is the most powerful thing here
